about: keel's commands for terminal clients: keel TUI (cli/), the xal client (clients/xal) and any other front end. One table: names, arguments, help text, whether a command writes (decides a gate, starts or stops a flow), what its argument completes from, and local = it never calls keel, group = where /help lists it (groups gives their order). keel TUI builds its commands from it (cli/src/core/commands.ts, a test keeps both the same). Every request a client sends says who acts: X-Keel-Via (tui, xal, mcp), X-Keel-Client (its name and version) and X-Keel-Tool (the command); the api records a write as a <via>.call event.

commands.name: help
commands.summary: what keel TUI can do

commands.name: project
commands.summary: pick the project (or switch to one by name)

commands.name: flow

commands.name: flows
commands.summary: this project's flows, newest first

commands.name: resume

commands.name: stop

commands.name: run

commands.name: status

commands.name: next

commands.name: answer

commands.name: jobs

commands.name: agent

commands.name: live

commands.name: steps

commands.name: timeline

commands.name: workflows

commands.name: diagram

commands.name: rules

commands.name: skills

commands.name: skill

commands.name: plugins
commands.summary: the plugins keel has, and which are on here

commands.name: budget

commands.name: dashboard

commands.name: model

commands.name: panel

commands.name: clear

commands.name: mouse
